item.title: audit.p0.defect.accessibility-boilerplate: audit-p0-accessibility-boilerplate
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: /accessibility/ generic boilerplate. Evidence: Claims unverified features (haptic feedback, closed captioning), references www.csoai.org, targets WCAG 2.1 (EAA baseline is 2.2).. Fix: Rewrite accessibility statement WCAG 2.2 AA..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-agent-card-html: audit-p0-asisecurity-agent-card-html
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai /.well-known/agent-card.json returns homepage HTML. Evidence: Working card at /agent.json but well-known path dead.. Fix: Serve agent-card.json content at well-known path..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-http: audit-p0-asisecurity-http
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai serves full site over plain HTTP. Evidence: No 301, no HSTS, no X-Frame-Options.. Fix: Force HTTPS, add security headers..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-mcp-dead: audit-p0-asisecurity-mcp-dead
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai/mcp: POST → 405. Evidence: Site's own /connect/mcp documents this as PAID integration path. Revenue-adjacent break.. Fix: Implement POST handler for /mcp endpoint..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-no-404: audit-p0-asisecurity-no-404
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai no 404 — every bogus path returns 200. Evidence: Masks D-04/D-05, poisons indexing.. Fix: Add proper 404 handling..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-no-disclosure: audit-p0-asisecurity-no-disclosure
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai no Companies Act / E-Commerce disclosure. Evidence: No company name, number, registered office in HTML.. Fix: Add footer: 'CSOAI Ltd, England & Wales No. 16939677, 3rd Floor, 86-90 Paul Street, London EC2A 4NE'..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-no-legal: audit-p0-asisecurity-no-legal
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai no privacy/terms/cookies. Evidence: Five live Stripe checkout links. UK GDPR / PECR / E-Commerce Regs unmet.. Fix: Host /privacy /terms /cookies on asisecurity.ai itself..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.asisecurity-no-security-txt: audit-p0-asisecurity-no-security-txt
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: asisecurity.ai no security.txt. Evidence: Security-evidence product with no security contact.. Fix: Add valid security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.ceremony-bitcoin-copy: audit-p0-ceremony-bitcoin-copy
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Ceremony Bitcoin copy contradiction. Evidence: Chip reads CONFIRMED_BITCOIN blocks 966712 while body copy says 'pending until upgraded proof names block'. Must agree.. Fix: Replace 'pending' sentence with confirmed-copy naming block 966712..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.github-repo-stale: audit-p0-github-repo-stale
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: GitHub repo description stale. Evidence: Description says '197 cards root 0dd5a8d9' vs live '335 cards root 761ba64f… 257 leaves'.. Fix: Update GitHub repo description field..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.hf-superseded-spaces: audit-p0-hf-superseded-spaces
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Three SUPERSEDED-but-Running HF Spaces. Evidence: Erodes 'one living board' story. HF Spaces = 39 working +1 org README, never quote '40'.. Fix: Archive superseded Spaces..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.homepage-jsonld-split: audit-p0-homepage-jsonld-split
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Homepage JSON-LD conflates card path with root witness. Evidence: JSON-LD says 'OpenTimestamps not yet wired' while same page shows CONFIRMED_BITCOIN block 966712.. Fix: State split: cards have timestamp_authority=none; root.json carries OTS witness confirmed at block 966712..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.infographic-typos: audit-p0-infographic-typos
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Infographic baked-in text defects. Evidence: 'The CSDAI engine', 'LLKl-as-judge', '3KB CREDENTIAL' typos visible within one homepage scroll.. Fix: Regenerate/proofread these four images..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.lookup-404: audit-p0-lookup-404
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: /lookup 404s. Evidence: gspc-lookup HF Space runs but IA implies Lookup page.. Fix: Restore or redirect /lookup to the HF Space..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.names-entities-page: audit-p0-names-entities-page
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Six public names no 'Names & entities' page. Evidence: Council of AI / CSOAI / CSOAI Ltd / councilof.ai / csoai.org / MEOK AI Labs / meok.ai with no gloss.. Fix: Add 5-line 'Names' block on /about + /press..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.ots-mime-type: audit-p0-ots-mime-type
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: .ots served as spreadsheet MIME. Evidence: Downloadable Bitcoin proof linked from ceremony page mis-opens (application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet-template).. Fix: Map .ots → application/octet-stream in host MIME table..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.press-stale-settlement: audit-p0-press-stale-settlement
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Press page stale against source. Evidence: Press says 'first settlement NOT HAPPENED' while /api/revenue shows $0.02 / 1 payer MEASURED.. Fix: Update line: 'first settlement — HAPPENED: 1 non-self payer, $0.02 total'.

item.title: audit.p0.defect.pricing-renders-os: audit-p0-pricing-renders-os
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: /pricing renders Council OS workspace shell. Evidence: Most surprising dead end for a buyer.. Fix: Build real /pricing page with tiers..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.privacy-policy-missing: audit-p0-privacy-policy-missing
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: councilof.ai no operative privacy policy. Evidence: /privacy is withdrawn placeholder; /privacy-policy renders badges + shell only. UK GDPR Arts 12-14 unmet.. Fix: Adapt meok.ai/privacy text (same controller). Same-day..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.sitemap-stale: audit-p0-sitemap-stale
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Sitemap serves ~300 stale csoai.org URLs. Evidence: Lastmod 2026-08-06 from councilof.ai host.. Fix: Regenerate sitemap with current dates..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.smithery-duplicate: audit-p0-smithery-duplicate
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Smithery stale duplicate csoai/gspc. Evidence: Still live; llms.txt description stale.. Fix: Remove duplicate listing..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.terms-contradict: audit-p0-terms-contradict
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Terms contradict entity and doctrine. Evidence: Says 'not-for-profit' (CSOAI Ltd is private limited with shareholders). References csoai.org. Has 'Certification Services… revoked' clause.. Fix: Rewrite terms to match CSOAI Ltd private limited status and 'measurement not certification' doctrine..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.tool-count-drift: audit-p0-tool-count-drift
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: Tool-count drift across four surfaces. Evidence: Registry: 8 free + 4 x402 / llms.txt same / npm: 7 free + 5 metered / Smithery: 7 tools.. Fix: Pick live tools/list as only source; regenerate all blurbs..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.watchdog-cert-violation: audit-p0-watchdog-cert-violation
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: 'Watchdog Cert £4,950' violates doctrine. Evidence: Word 'Cert' violates 'measurement not certification' AND asisecurity agent.json 'never certifications'.. Fix: Rename: 'Watchdog Evidence Pack'..

item.title: audit.p0.defect.www-csoai-tls: audit-p0-www-csoai-tls
item.description: AUDIT P0 DEFECT: www.csoai.org TLS timeout. Evidence: TLS/listener missing on www variant; apex 308 chain intact.. Fix: Edge rule + cert mirroring apex..

item.title: automation.revenue.machine: csoai-automated-machine
item.description: The machine: 17 readers on cron → ≤4KB signed cards → one feed → one x402 gateway → one attribution layer. Free distribution, paid proofs, $199/mo firehose. When the root is triple-anchored (OTS+Rekor+XRPL), the premium tier opens. 425 stablecoins indexed cheaply, top 20 deep-measured. Every new measurement = new SKU = zero new infrastructure.

item.title: automation.improvement.plan: automation-improvement-plan

Medium: ASI-Evolve, auto-crosswalk updates, feed distribution, Dune dashboard. Long: fully autonomous self-healing self-expanding self-monetizing.
